style.styleTitle: Personalised Metallic Family Snowflake Christmas Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: An intricate personalised bauble, engraved with your family members' names on a shimmering metallic laminate snowflake. The silver metallic snowflake within this glass bauble can be personalised with up to 5 family members' names. Please only enter names for the number you require. The layout of the family members' names will depend on the number of names you select. Please refer to the images for details of each layout. The centre of the silver snowflake can also be customised with up to 3 short lines of text, such as your family name & the year. No text is included as standard, so enter the text exactly as you’d like it to appear and refer to the images for the formatting. Choose from gold or silver metallic laminate to fit your Christmas decor theme and add a personal touch to your home this festive period. Baubles measure 10cm and are finished with velvet ribbon in your choice of colour.
